title: 3531. Count Covered Buildings

examples.explanation: Only building [2,2] is covered as it has at least one building: above ([1,2]) below ([3,2]) left ([2,1]) right ([2,3]) Thus, the count of covered buildings is 1.
No building has at least one building in all four directions.
Only building [3,3] is covered as it has at least one building: above ([1,3]) below ([5,3]) left ([3,2]) right ([3,5]) Thus, the count of covered buildings is 1.
